title:	[FEATURE] Add PHP language support via tree-sitter-php grammar
state:	OPEN
author:	clouatre (Hugues Clouâtre)
labels:	enhancement, feat, feature, testing

## Summary

Add PHP language support to aptu-coder using the official `tree-sitter-php` grammar. After this change, `analyze_directory`, `analyze_file` and `analyze_module` extract functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums, calls, imports and inheritance from `.php` files instead of returning the unsupported-extension fallback.

## Context

- PHP is one of the most widely deployed server-side languages and is absent from the registry: no `php` in `EXTENSION_MAP` (`crates/aptu-coder-core/src/lang.rs`), no handler in `crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/`, no `tree-sitter-php` in `Cargo.lock`.
- aptu-coder already supports mainstream languages such as Java, Kotlin, Swift and TypeScript. PHP should follow the same registry pattern as the existing object-oriented languages.

## Prerequisites

None.

## Where to Look

- **Handler templates:** `crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/java.rs` (an OO language with `extends` / `implements`) and `swift.rs` (inheritance through named children, inline tests).
- **Grammar:** the `tree-sitter-php` repository on GitHub. Node kinds and field names come from `php/src/node-types.json`; the crate entry points are on docs.rs.
- **Registry:** `languages/mod.rs` (handler registration) and `lang.rs` (extension map and supported-language list).

The Scout research output is written to `exp5-output.json` and passes `python3 -m json.tool`. The file is the only thing I wrote; the clone is unchanged.

**Recommendation:** Approach A, a full registry mirror of the Swift and Java wiring. It uses `tree-sitter-php` 0.25.2 with `LANGUAGE_PHP`, which covers the HTML-template case. It fills all five query slots and `extract_inheritance`, and touches about 11 files. Approach B (elements only) would fail the call, import and defuse acceptance criteria. Approach C (a second `LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY` key) is out of scope.

**Key findings:**
- **Grammar, verified against `node-types.json` and `define-grammar.js`:** `class_declaration`, `interface_declaration`, `trait_declaration` and `enum_declaration` all have a `name` field. `function_definition` and `method_declaration` have `name` as well. Calls use `function_call_expression`, `member_call_expression` and `scoped_call_expression`, each with a `name` or `function` field.
- **Inheritance:** `base_clause` and `class_interface_clause` are unfielded children, so the walk iterates `node.children`. Interfaces also use `base_clause` for `extends`.
- **Import fallback:** `extract_imports_from_node` has no PHP arm, so `namespace_use_declaration` would be stored as the whole `use ...;` text. Splitting it into items would need a new arm.
- **Defuse:** PHP locals are `variable_name` nodes including the `$`, so the symbol passed to defuse must include the sigil.
- **Crate age:** the `v0.25.2` tag is dated 2026-11-19, about 8 days old. The crates.io `created_at` was not checked, so the 7-day gate is unverified.
- **Maintainer note:** #1864 says external PRs are not accepted; the maintainers implement it in-house.
